description: TerraShift+ turns NASA Earth observations into a human story of generational farming resilience. Inspired by families navigating erratic rainfall and soil depletion, our mission bridges satellites (SMAP, POWER, ECOSTRESS) with soil biology to craft 5-year regenerative crop rotations. We are AI, MLOps, and software engineers seeking passionate storytellers, creative communicators, and agronomists to transform scientific data into a compelling global narrative for farmers in Africa and worldwide.
